history.summary: A 3BR at Prestige Point, a small 2016 freehold boutique near Serangoon (D19), asking $1.58M ($1,688 psf). Freehold and a compact efficient 936 sqft help, but the thin URA series (5 txns) shows -5%/yr and the asking sits ~12% above the development's $1,508 median PSF.
history.rating_rationale: $1,688 psf vs URA median $1,508 psf means the listing is ~12% above the project's recent transacted level, into a (thin, 5-txn, so low-confidence) -5%/yr reading. Freehold + a sensibly-sized 936 sqft 3BR keep it from Avoid, but boutique scale limits liquidity and the price/appreciation signals are unfavorable. Needs a price closer to ~$1,508 psf to be compelling.
red_flags: Asking ~12% above development median PSF ($1,688 vs $1,508)
